background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, the group carries the strong ratings typical of a custodian with a low-risk balance sheet. Leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, but CET1 of 12.0% is just below the median and LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, the weak spot. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points, while LCR has been broadly flat. The newest flagged items, on 7 Oct 2026, concern taking over fund administration work from another bank, a business development rather than a credit concern.
